blocks.text: Charlie Puth has expressed surprise that his upcoming Manila concert is the only stop on his Asia tour that has yet to sell out. The American singer-songwriter took to TikTok to raise his queries about the ticket situation for his Manila concert scheduled on Oct. 14. “The only show not sold out on the Asia stadium / arena tour is….. The Philippines?!?” read the text in a video Puth posted on TikTok. “Do we not talk anymore for real, Philippines?” he added in the caption, referencing his 2016 hit “We Don’t Talk Anymore.” LOOK: Charlie Puth announces birth of first child […]...
